proposals.title: Exposure concentration: by_signal_direction (UP_TRI + BULL_PROXY directional-long) = directional_long (94.3%)

claim.what: Concentration risk: by_signal_direction (UP_TRI + BULL_PROXY directional-long) = directional_long; recommended action: Pause new entries in signal_type=UP_TRI and BULL_PROXY until either (a) Choppy×UP_TRI cohort validates to Tier M/S, or (b) directional-long share drops below 85% via natural Day-6 exits. Consider a short hedge on the largest concentrated cell (UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank, 8 positions) via a Bank-index put or short-Bank pair to offset regime-flip tail risk.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: If Choppy regime flips to Bear or a sharp risk-off event hits, 94% of the book is directional-long with no validated edge to justify holding through drawdown — the Bank concentration (8 positions, 15% of book) amplifies single-sector shock, and unvalidated Candidate-tier cohort means historical WR/edge cannot be relied upon to size through the shock.

decision_metadata.llm_rationale: No hard threshold is breached — regime concentration at 64.15% Choppy sits below 0.80, top cell UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank at 15.09% is below 0.20, and UP_TRI at 42/53 = 79.2% is below 0.85. However, combined with BULL_PROXY (8) and DOWN_TRI (3), directional-long exposure is 50/53 = 94.3%, effectively a monoculture, and the matched Choppy×UP_TRI cohort remains Candidate-tier (n=373) — unvalidated edge. This extends a multi-week warn streak of directional-long exposure without cohort validation.
